publicBeta.welcome: Welcome to CompassCAD NEXT Public Beta!

segments.body_segment1: Welcome to the CompassCAD NEXT Desktop Public Beta! We're proud that you are here!
segments.body_segment2: Before you can get started, we'd like to warn you of the following things.

warns.doNotDailyDrive: Please do not daily drive this version of CompassCAD yet.
warns.lotsOfBugs: Keep in mind that there will be LOTS OF BUGS, incomplete/unfunctional buttons.
warns.missingFeatures: There will be a LOT of missing features/buttons than desktop/web.
warns.noSettingChange: There are no ways for you to change settings (as of now). If you want to, you'll need to get hacky.
warns.alternative: If you want somewhere to still daily drive, use CompassCAD Desktop (< 2.1.0) or the web.

segments.askForConsent: With that out of the way, let's start by checking "I Consent" and then closing this popup.
segments.checkListConsent: I consent that there will be bugs and I will be responsible for design losses.
segments.riskAccepted: Risk accepted. We won't show you this dialog, but please beware. You're entering dangerous beta territory.

general.name: Name

drawing.moveHint: Move (click a node point to select, Esc to cancel)

settings.mcpHelp: Connect local AI agents to this drawing. Each session has a labeled colored cursor. Changes use the normal undo history. Settings take effect after Save; connection changes disconnect existing agents.
settings.mcpSavedError: Preferences saved, but the MCP server could not start:
settings.mcpClientHelp: Copy this draft configuration into an MCP client supporting Streamable HTTP and authorization headers, then Save. Keep the token private. The app must remain open. Agents idle for 30 minutes are disconnected.
settings.title: Settings
settings.fontHelp: Font face applies to drawing text. Font size applies to new labels.
settings.error: Could not save settings. Your changes have not been applied.
settings.invalidSize: Font size must be between 1 and 256.
settings.gridHelp: Custom spacing in drawing units: 1 drawing unit = 1 cm. Also available in the toolbar.
settings.unitsHelp: Changes measurement labels and toolbar units without scaling geometry. Inspector coordinates remain in drawing units (cm).
settings.undoHelp: Maximum saved states (10–500). Lower limits take effect on the next edit.
settings.invalidNumbers: Check the numeric settings: grid spacing 0.01–100000 cm, selection tolerance 1–50 px, decimal places 0–6, and undo history 10–500.
settings.previewError: Unable to load the font preview.

contextMenu.title: Canvas actions
contextMenu.factor: Scale factor k (for example, 2 doubles the size)
contextMenu.invalid: Enter a finite scale factor greater than zero.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.help: Allow and Deny decisions are remembered across restarts. Changed extension code requests consent again. Reset permissions and Save to choose again. Uncheck and Save to deactivate an extension.
extensions.canvas: Canvas access is always available. OS access is limited to the permissions listed above.
extensions.consent: Before activating {name}, {name} would like to request some permissions from you:

permissions.web_request: Web requests: send and receive HTTP(S) data, including Internet and local network addresses.
permissions.server_listen: Local server: host up to four HTTP servers on 127.0.0.1. Other programs on this computer can connect.
permissions.filesystem_read: Read files: read text files and list folders anywhere your account can access.
permissions.filesystem_write: Write files: create or overwrite text files, create folders, and delete files anywhere your account can access.

documentProperties.title: Document Properties
documentProperties.name: Document name
documentProperties.author: Author
documentProperties.nameHelp: The document name is independent of the filename. It is suggested when first saving the design.
documentProperties.canvasHelp: Start with an unbounded canvas or a real-world paper template. Paper and margins are guides centered on the origin; geometry outside them remains editable.
documentProperties.scaleHelp: Scale is paper : real world. At 1:100, 1 cm on paper represents 1 m in the design. Use 2:1 for an enlargement. Scale controls paper coverage; it does not change geometry or viewport zoom. Paper guides provide a layout reference.
documentProperties.unitsHelp: Geometry is always stored in centimetres. Document units and precision override application measurement defaults for this design only.
documentProperties.storageHelp: Apply changes to this design, then save to .cnext to keep them. Legacy .ccad files contain geometry only and cannot store document properties.
documentProperties.invalid: Check all tabs: sizes and scale values must be between 0.001 and 1,000,000, margins must leave a positive drawing area, and decimal places must be an integer from 0 to 6.
documentProperties.fitPaper: Fit paper in view after applying
documentProperties.legacyWarning: Export geometry only to legacy .ccad? Document properties, paper settings, scale and measurement preferences will not be included. Save a .cnext copy to preserve them.
documentProperties.unsupported: Choose a supported document extension (.cnext or .ccad for saving).
documentProperties.showTitleBlock: Show drawing border and title block
documentProperties.titleBlockHelp: A stroke-font title block sits inside the bottom-left margin and updates from General properties. The border and title block follow the paper scale, are not selectable geometry, and are stored only in .cnext.
documentProperties.startSubtitle: Pick a paper template, set your size, and start drawing.
documentProperties.customDimensionHelp: Edit either dimension to create a custom paper size.
documentProperties.infiniteDimensionHelp: No paper edges. Enter dimensions to switch to a custom sheet.
